reason: Neogen Chemicals' operations are set to normalize as the Gujarat Pollution Control Board has revoked earlier directions and granted a CC&A Amendment, removing a significant operational overhang.
why_now: The GPCB order for revocation and CC&A Amendment was announced today, November 8, 2026, directly impacting the company's operational status.
source_headlines: Neogen Chemicals Limited: Neogen Chemicals Limited has informed the Exchange about Update on Fire Incident - Order for Revocation of earlier Directions issued by GPCB and granting of CC&A Amendment by GPCB.
